messages:
Elena Rossi: FYI Thicket Labs private cutover post-mortem sync. peering test failed with RSTs. trying to lock down root cause before Wed cutover. any quick wins?
Marcus Quinn: their NGW returned RSTs on the peering handshake. likely MTU mismatch or asymmetric routing. asked their netops to traceroute from a host in 10.210.0.0/16 to our 10.77.0.0/16.
Nina Shah: they prefer BYOK for KMS and requested key policy that limits decrypt to our role only. asked for sample policy and alias.
Omar Farouk: audit path: they want Splunk HEC -> PrivateLink. need HEC fqdn and token; also confirm S3 endpoint used for raw audit delivery.
Marcus Quinn: quick peering snippet for them to run: ```bash
aws ec2 accept-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-07e4a2b1
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-01a2b3c4 --destination-cidr-block 10.77.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-07e4a2b1
```
Nina Shah: sample trust policy (they should replace OUR_ACCOUNT_ID): ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::OUR_ACCOUNT_ID:root"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}```
Omar Farouk: Splunk HEC: they said PrivateLink ready; we need DNS entries + endpoint policy. fallback plan: NAT gateway + forwarder IPs 54.220.33.10/11.
Elena Rossi: renewal watch: they mentioned "stability anxiety" after last staging hiccup. plan: Friday dry-run + 48h SLA report and a Dedicated trial offer. can we get a one-pager?
Marcus Quinn: will assemble a 1-page latency p99 summary and recommended mitigation (prefix cache + smaller model variant for canary).
Nina Shah: I'll prepare KMS alias: alias/redwood/thicket-prod and a policy that allows kms:Decrypt only when aws:SourceVpc = "vpc-0a1b2c3d". include CloudTrail selector for KMS events.
infra-bot: audit-bucket: thicket-audit-prod delivery OK, last PUT 2024-06-14T09:03:21Z.
Elena Rossi: action items: (1) Marcus -> peering/MTU checklist + run dry-run Fri 10:00 PT (2) Nina -> KMS policy + alias draft (3) Omar -> Splunk PrivateLink validation steps + fallback IPs (4) Elena -> renewal one-pager and trial proposal. I'll send invites now.
Omar Farouk: added 3-question feedback to runbook: network clarity, KMS instructions, cutover readiness.
Elena Rossi: thanks team. we'll re-evaluate renewal risk after dry-run and share notes with RevOps. :white_check_mark:
